sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: European spindle (Euonymus europaeus) is a deciduous shrub or small tree of hedges and woodland margins in Europe. It usually reaches 2.5–4 m in height and spread.

sections.title: Fruit and seeds
sections.text: Its pink, four-lobed capsules split when ripe to reveal orange seeds wrapped in an aril, conspicuous in autumn.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The seeds, leaves and bark are poisonous. Do not eat the fruits or seeds.
